'''Siyaram Silk Mills Ltd''', also known as '''Siyaram's''' or '''SSM''',<ref name="Bagade20130226"></ref> is an Indian [[textile|blended fabric]] and [[Textile manufacturing|garment manufacturing]] [[company]],<ref name="Naidu20140529"></ref> with an associated chain of [[retail outlet]]s, and [[showroom|branded showroom]]s. Siyaram's was incorporated in 1978,<ref name="NDTV"></ref> and has its [[headquarters]] in the Kamala Mills compound, [[Lower Parel]], [[Mumbai]].<ref name="Address"></ref>

==Structure==
Siyaram Silk Mills Ltd. (SSM) is a subsidiary of the Siyaram Poddar Group, the parent company of Balkrishna Industries Ltd. and Govind Rubber Ltd., which are all listed companies on the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]].<ref>Govind Rubber Limited Announced Business Expansion Plan. India PRwire July 19, 2012 [http://www.indiaprwire.com/pressrelease/textiles/20120719125588.htm]</ref> SSM is a [[small cap company|small-cap company]] with a [[market capitalization]] of ₹936.75 crores.<ref name="companyid-13098"></ref> Siyaram manufactures and sells [[fabrics]],<ref name="RD20141010"></ref> ready-made men's and women's apparel, home furnishings, and yarns.<ref name="Bagade20130226"></ref><ref name="NDTV"></ref><ref name="HBL"></ref><ref name="ITV20141105"></ref> SSM is associated with one [[lakh]] [[retail outlet]]s,<ref name="Naidu20140529"></ref> and has over 170 branded showrooms across the country.<ref name="ITV20141105"></ref> In the March 2014 quarter, the company's annual [[Net income|net profit]] was ₹20.2 crores.<ref name="Naidu20140529"></ref> Siyaram produces over 4 million meters of fabric per month, totalling over 60 million meters annually.<ref>{{cite web|title=Interview with Shri Ramesh Poddar, MD of Siyaram Silk Mills Ltd.|url=http://www.textilevaluechain.com/index.php/business-gyan/interviews/item/497-interview-with-shri-ramesh-poddar-md-of-siyaram-silk-mills-ltd.|website=www.textilevaluechain.com}}</ref>

==Product line==
According to [[The Economic Times]], [[polyester]] [[viscose]], which is derived from [[crude oil]], accounts for approximately 85% of Siyaram's [[raw material]].<ref name="Naidu20140529"></ref> In 2014, Siyaram reported 80% of its revenue came from fabric sales, 16% from garments, and 4% from [[yarn]].<ref name="Naidu20140529"></ref> Siyaram's weaving capacity is approximately 80 million meters and its garment production capacity is around 40 lakh pieces annually.<ref name="Naidu20140529"></ref>

Like some other [[textile manufacturer]]s, Siyaram's has produced the [[Ready-to-wear|ready-made garment]] (RMG) sector. Starting in 2004,<ref name="ET2004"></ref> the company introduced product lines including [[Furniture|home furnishings]], [[Uniform|uniforms]], children's apparel, and [[Clothing|women's clothing]].<ref name="Sangeetha2013"></ref>

}}

On 24 September 2015 Siyaram's Silk Mills announced a partnership with Italian brand Cadini<ref name="ETCadini"></ref><ref name="BSCadini"></ref> at an event held at Sahara Star in [[Mumbai]].
